Font Awesome Free 6.4.0, unmodified, served from this theme instead of
Cloudflare's cdnjs so no visitor's internet address is sent to Cloudflare's CDN.

css/all.min.css   from cdnjs (font-awesome/6.4.0), matches its published SRI hash
webfonts/*.woff2  from the @fortawesome/fontawesome-free 6.4.0 package
LICENSE.txt       from the Font Awesome 6.4.0 release

Icons: CC BY 4.0. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1. Code: MIT. See LICENSE.txt.
Only the WOFF2 font files are included; every current browser uses them.
